name: Member list
summary: A workspace's members with their email, a role picker per person, last active time, a pending invite you can resend and the owner's locked role.
use: in team or workspace settings, to manage people and roles
a11y: Each role is a native select labelled with the person's name; the resend button names the invitee; on narrow widths the rows restack without hiding anything.

use_when: a seat-limited plan where admins change roles and chase pending invites in one place
avoid_when: sending new invites with emails and a role: use invite-members
one person's public profile: use profile-card
a history of role changes: use audit-log

parts.name: invite
parts.what: the main action, to invite people

parts.name: columns
parts.what: column labels, hidden in a narrow box

parts.name: members
parts.what: one member or pending invite: who, role and last active

parts.name: avatar
parts.what: the person's photo, or a dashed mail icon for an invite

parts.name: name
parts.what: name, with a 'You' tag for the viewer; the email for an invite

parts.name: email
parts.what: email, or the invite's pending tag, sender and expiry

parts.name: locked
parts.what: the owner's role, with a lock instead of a picker

parts.name: when
parts.what: last active time, 'Active now', or the resend button

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if a role change or resend fails, put the old role back and show the reason in toast-stack

disabled.how: the owner's role has no picker: a lock and the word Owner, with a tooltip saying why
disabled.evidence: The owner's role can be changed only by transferring ownership

overflow.how: the list shows every row it is given; for a large team, cap it and add filter-bar search and pagination below

long_text.how: emails break anywhere to fit, names wrap with their tags, and in a narrow box each row restacks with the role and time under the name

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches Invite, then each role picker, then the Resend button
Arrow keys or Space open and change a role picker, as in any native select
Enter or Space presses Invite or Resend
